decisions.reason: The source also changes the Unit 1 en-suite bathroom, but its existing message-56 MODIFY already records the new toilet and washing-machine locations and removes the obsolete shower_location key.
The red and yellow markings in the source refer to the two Unit 1 bathrooms, not the separately marked Unit 3 kitchen-counter arrangement.
Local context limits the requested fixture revision to the two Unit 1 bathrooms; it does not change the Unit 3 bathroom layout.
Local context resolves the plural bathroom reference to the common and en-suite bathrooms in Unit 1, not the Unit 2 bathroom.
Changing fixture locations inside the Unit 1 bathrooms does not alter the common corridor or entrance-area allocation.
The source changes toilet and washing-machine locations but does not direct construction, demolition, or preservation of any wall.
Bathroom fixture placement does not change the open-plan kitchen configuration or cabinetry dimensions.
The fixture revision does not change Unit 1's 2+1 configuration, bedroom count, or living-area count.
The source does not change the number, material, or allocation of private unit entrance doors.
The Unit 1 bathroom fixture revision is unrelated to retaining or enclosing the Unit 3 balcony.
Although the revised fixtures may appear in the architectural plan, the source does not change the separate furnished-drawing deliverable or its listed contents.
The bathroom fixture revision does not affect retention or shared use of the existing main entrance.
